claim: VariantShift measures task-level transport failure and uses only outcome-free task and model properties to select a model or abstain before confirmation measurements are revealed.

primary_endpoints.utility: within-task standardized selection gain among the top-scored decile
primary_endpoints.failure: standardized selection gain less than or equal to zero
primary_endpoints.reliability: area under the task-level risk-coverage curve

task_weighting: Each assay receives equal weight; no assay is weighted by its number of measured variants.

hierarchy: Pfam clan or MMseqs2 fallback family
bootstrap.primary_contrast: VariantShift risk-coverage AUC minus the strongest frozen label-free comparator

comparators: always deploy the best average ProteinGym model

selector.method: cross-fitted histogram gradient boosting with group-calibrated one-sided conformal lower bounds
selector.grouping: Pfam clan with MMseqs2 family fallback
selector.decision: select the model with the largest lower bound only when that bound exceeds zero; otherwise abstain

panel_rules.domainome: All frozen targets; higher abundance score is favorable.
panel_rules.mavedb_complement: Only target-acquisition rows selected before outcome download; use the frozen registry metadata orientation.
panel_rules.venusmuthub: Only activity assays with a deterministic direction; higher is favorable except Km, where lower is favorable. Signed selectivity assays are excluded as directionally ambiguous.

model_coverage.model_specific_ineligibility: Retain in the failure audit and exclude from that model's usable target set; never impute variant scores.

confirmatory_tests.multiplicity: Primary pooled risk-coverage contrast is tested first; panel-specific contrasts are gated and reported with Holm adjustment.
confirmatory_tests.missingness: Report complete-model intersection and model-available sensitivity analyses.

figures: failure rate and selection gain at 50% task coverage
sequence, clan, structure, and exposure subgroup forest plot
outcome_access_policy: No confirmation effect or measurement file may be mounted, decoded, or hashed before this complete bundle is frozen and publicly registered.
